destination.title: Fields, gravity and cosmology: construction and tests
destination.question: How are field and gravitational descriptions constructed and tested, how do their geometries and matter sectors determine physical behavior and cosmological histories, and what can observations or probabilistic inference establish?

sources.title: A Novel string derived Z-prime with stable proton, light-neutrinos and R-parity violation

evidence.text: Can a low-energy Abelian gauge symmetry protect the proton without obstructing fermion masses or a neutrino seesaw? The proposed symmetry must also be family universal and anomaly free.

sources.title: A Novel string derived Z-prime with stable proton, light-neutrinos and R-parity violation

evidence.text: Can the extra proton-protecting U(1) coexist with light active neutrinos? The neutral singlets and heavy-singlet Higgs VEV provide operators that preserve the residual gauge symmetry while generating a seesaw mass matrix.

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Does gauge invariance itself prevent local observables and time evolution? Introducing coordinate fields in nondynamical flat geometry shows that the relevant obstruction is dynamical gravity, which makes causal separation fluctuate and requires physical clocks.

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Can low-curvature Hamiltonian evolution on nice slices describe an entire unitary evaporation? The reviewed paradox contrasts the entropy increase predicted by independent interior and exterior degrees of freedom with the shrinking information capacity assigned to the hole.

sources.title: The Lee-Wick standard model

evidence.text: The proposed extension seeks Higgs-mass stabilization by adding higher derivative kinetic operators throughout the Standard Model. Each operator introduces a massive resonance rather than a new stable asymptotic particle, with its mass initially independent of the masses in other representations.

sources.title: The Lee-Wick standard model

evidence.text: The hierarchy problem asks why the Higgs mass remains small compared with a very high ultraviolet scale. This paper investigates whether higher derivative kinetic operators and their massive Lee-Wick resonances can remove quadratic radiative sensitivity while retaining a usable perturbative theory.

sources.title: Are we typical?

evidence.text: How should one ask what observers could have measured if a now-known quantity had been unknown? The paper requires a physical specification of which records may vary and which features continue to identify the conditioning system.

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Can all subsystem entropies of one holographic state determine its classical bulk geometry? The proposed advantage over null-endpoint data is sensitivity to the metric's conformal factor and access to deeper bulk regions.

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Can entanglement between otherwise noninteracting boundary theories explain nonzero correlations associated with a connected multiple-boundary bulk wormhole?

sources.title: An area law for one-dimensional quantum systems

evidence.text: How much entanglement can occur across a cut in the unique ground state of a finite one-dimensional chain when interaction range, interaction strength, and the excitation gap are controlled?

sources.title: Schwinger pair production at finite temperature in scalar QED

evidence.text: How should an initial thermal fermion state be propagated through a time-dependent electric background, and how does the produced current alter that background? Both questions require ingredients beyond the fixed-background bosonic occupation calculation.

sources.title: Higgs physics as a window beyond the MSSM (BMSSM)

evidence.text: Which heavy-threshold interactions dominate Higgs observables when the new sector is approximately supersymmetric? The answer depends jointly on the heavy-scale ratios and η = cot β.

sources.title: Higgs physics as a window beyond the MSSM (BMSSM)

evidence.text: What is the constrained scalar-Higgs baseline against which new interactions are compared? Once v is fixed, the tree-level MSSM spectrum depends on mA and tan β.

sources.title: Higgs physics as a window beyond the MSSM (BMSSM)

evidence.text: Can discrepancies between measured Higgs masses and MSSM predictions, after determining the stop sector, reveal heavy additional degrees of freedom? Correlated Higgs and electroweakino observables provide further tests of the proposed effective interactions.

sources.title: Higgs physics as a window beyond the MSSM (BMSSM)

evidence.text: Can a broken additional gauge interaction provide Higgs quartic corrections while its vector multiplet is integrated out?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Which supersymmetry-breaking contributions can cancel a small negative vacuum energy without overwhelming the non-perturbatively generated gravitino scale? The source explores existing uplift proposals and their compatibility with flux-stabilized sectors.

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Can non-geometric fluxes generate an exponentially small gravitino mass while retaining a high string scale and stabilizing all moduli, by first constructing perturbative W=0 Minkowski vacua and then introducing small non-perturbative effects?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Can a non-geometric flux sector generate the small constants needed by an ISS supersymmetry-breaking sector while stabilizing its gauge-coupling modulus perturbatively?

sources.title: Smallness of the cosmological constant and the multiple point principle

evidence.text: How can a supergravity model with broken local supersymmetry avoid a vacuum energy density of order m_{3/2}²M_Pl² and account for a much smaller positive cosmological energy density?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in (string) model building: Gauge fluxes and loops

evidence.text: Can gauge-flux D-terms, a Scherk-Schwarz source for a constant superpotential, and gaugino condensation consistently stabilize the dilaton and volume moduli, and do flux-induced quantum corrections preserve the resulting minimum?

sources.title: Viscosity Bound Violation in Higher Derivative Gravity

evidence.text: Can curvature-squared corrections violate the conjectured KSS bound η/s ≥ 1/(4π), and do violations correlate with bulk pathologies, inconsistent boundary theories, or restrictions on quantum-gravity embeddings?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture for the Effective Field Theories with N Species

evidence.text: How is the gauge weak-gravity cutoff altered when N separated abelian gauge sectors share the same bulk gravity?

sources.title: Stabilizing moduli with thermal matter and nonperturbative effects

evidence.text: Can gaugino-condensation stabilization of the dilaton coexist with radion stabilization by enhanced-symmetry momentum/winding strings, without their combined dynamics destabilizing either modulus? The paper presents a preliminary answer under simplifying approximations.

sources.title: The Viscosity Bound and Causality Violation

evidence.text: Does reducing shear viscosity in the Gauss-Bonnet holographic model eventually violate boundary microcausality, thereby imposing a consistency-related lower bound on η/s?

sources.title: On Super-Planckian Fields at Sub-Planckian Energies

evidence.text: Assuming super-Planckian scalar ranges exist, can an observer in asymptotically flat space source and measure them in a finite local experiment without excessive gravitational backreaction or collapse?

sources.title: Building a Holographic Superconductor

evidence.text: Can a simple gravitational model describe a strongly coupled 2+1-dimensional system with a charged condensate, a superconducting transition and a gap in its frequency-dependent conductivity?

sources.title: Relative entropy and the Bekenstein bound

evidence.text: Can the Bekenstein bound receive an unambiguous flat-space QFT formulation using localized, vacuum-subtracted entropy and modular energy, and does that formulation follow from semiclassical generalized-second-law arguments without an additional physical principle?

sources.title: Investigating the Ultraviolet Properties of Gravity with a Wilsonian Renormalization Group Equation

evidence.text: Does gravitational RG flow admit a non-Gaussian ultraviolet fixed point with finitely many attractive directions, and how robust is the evidence under changes of cutoff scheme and truncation?

sources.title: Global Fits of the Large Volume String Scenario to WMAP5 and Other Indirect Constraints Using Markov Chain Monte Carlo

evidence.text: Can the minimal Large Volume Scenario fit the paper's cosmological, electroweak, flavour and direct-search constraints, and how do the preferred parameters depend on priors and the sign of μ?

sources.title: (Un)attractor black holes in higher derivative AdS gravity

evidence.text: How do Gauss–Bonnet corrections affect renormalized charges, thermodynamics and scalar attractor behavior of static charged AdS black holes, including extremal solutions?

sources.title: A Novel string derived Z-prime with stable proton, light-neutrinos and R-parity violation

evidence.text: Replace specified parent-operator fields by their VEVs, preserve all cutoff powers, and impose the quoted coefficient limits. The output is conditional on both the integer insertion orders and the existence of the required charged fields.

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Replace a model-specific fluctuation analysis by the adiabatic time-shift sector of a spatial-diffeomorphism-invariant effective action. This isolates a necessary source of dangerous fluctuations without requiring a complete microscopic matter Lagrangian.

sources.title: The Lee-Wick standard model

evidence.text: Choose representation-matched auxiliary fields, verify their elimination reproduces the specified operator, and shift fields to diagonalize kinetic mixing. Keep all induced interactions and distinguish physical observables from gauge-dependent off-shell quantities when comparing formulations.

sources.title: Are we typical?

evidence.text: Choose and disclose a theory-prior weighting that implements the desired typicality preference, then update it using the ordinary data likelihood. The procedure separates preference from evidence and exposes how conclusions depend on that preference.

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Compare the radial metric factor with its pure-AdS value pointwise, then test the subtracted radial integral at zero and infinity. The explicit convergence conditions are added in the analytical reconstruction.

sources.title: An area law for one-dimensional quantum systems

evidence.text: Convert approximate ground-state projection into Schmidt-tail information, then sum shellwise entropy bounds. The operation separates an overlap assumption from the local Hamiltonian structure needed to turn it into a uniform entropy estimate.

sources.title: Gopakumar-Vafa invariants and the Emergent String Conjecture

evidence.text: Do gauge-coupling asymptotics and charged BPS indices distinguish decompactification from emergent-string limits in five-dimensional supergravity, and do Calabi-Yau data satisfy the resulting geometric predictions of the Emergent String Conjecture?

sources.title: Revisiting Scalar Tensor inflation by swampland criteria and Reheating

evidence.text: Can a scalar-dependent gravitational coupling accommodate slow-roll inflation, the observed scalar/tensor spectra, and the paper's swampland cuts? The study also asks which effective reheating equations of state give positive, relatively short expansion histories.

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture from conformal field theory: a challenge from hyperscaling violating and Kerr-Newman-AdS black holes

evidence.text: Can charged-scalar CFT correlation functions and their relaxation poles imply weak gravity conjecture conditions for hyperscaling violating (HSV) and Kerr-Newman-AdS (KNA) black holes, particularly near extremality?

sources.title: The ALP miracle: unified inflaton and dark matter

evidence.text: Can one light axion-like particle account for both hilltop inflation and the observed dark matter through incomplete reheating, while satisfying CMB normalization, scalar tilt, small-scale structure and photon-coupling constraints?

sources.title: Investigating the Ultraviolet Properties of Gravity with a Wilsonian Renormalization Group Equation

evidence.text: Does gravitational RG flow admit a non-Gaussian ultraviolet fixed point with finitely many attractive directions, and how robust is the evidence under changes of cutoff scheme and truncation?

sources.title: Renormalizability of Massive Gravity in Three Dimensions

evidence.text: Can three-dimensional new massive gravity be shown perturbatively renormalizable while preserving the special higher-derivative structure underlying its previously claimed unitary massive spin-2 spectrum?

sources.title: Emergent Spacetime and Holographic CFTs

evidence.text: Which CFTs admit useful weakly coupled holographic descriptions, and why would factorization and CFT consistency naturally lead an observer to introduce AdS fields and Witten diagrams?

sources.title: Renormalization of Higher Derivative Quantum Gravity Coupled to a Scalar with Shift Symmetry

evidence.text: Does gravity coupled to a shift-symmetric scalar remain perturbatively renormalizable when both kinetic terms and interactions contain up to four derivatives, and how does the answer depend on D = 3, 4 or 5?

sources.title: Further evidence for asymptotic safety of quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can an interacting ultraviolet fixed point of four-dimensional gravity be identified self-consistently as higher-curvature operators are added, and does canonical mass dimension remain a useful guide to operator relevance?

sources.title: The unitary conformal field theory behind 2D Asymptotic Safety

evidence.text: Can the Einstein–Hilbert truncation underlying Asymptotic Safety yield an intrinsically two-dimensional fixed-point theory compatible with Hilbert space positivity, and what are its central charge and gravitational dressing?

sources.title: The Conformal Bootstrap

evidence.text: How can conformal symmetry, unitarity and OPE consistency constrain strongly coupled CFTs without choosing a microscopic Lagrangian? These pedagogical lectures develop the foundations and introduce numerical applications to the 2d and 3d Ising models.

sources.title: de Sitter Space as a Resonance

evidence.text: Can metastable de Sitter space receive a potentially rigorous quantum definition as a resonance in transition amplitudes between particular excited states of asymptotically supersymmetric flat vacua? The diagnostic is a pole in a spectral representation of such an amplitude.

sources.title: Asymptotic safety of higher derivative quantum gravity non-minimally coupled with a matter system

evidence.text: Do four-derivative gravity and its non-minimal coupling to a Higgs–Yukawa toy model admit non-trivial UV fixed points, and which relevant directions survive changes of truncation and gauge parameters?

sources.title: Are tiny gauge couplings out of the Swampland?

evidence.text: Which holographic families admit a bulk expansion controlled by Newton's constant? The assumed CFT spectrum and factorization properties select an Einstein regime with finitely many light fields and C_T growing as N^2.

sources.title: Supersymmetric dS/CFT

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric Euclidean vector models define a well-behaved Hartle-Hawking wavefunction through dS/CFT, providing evidence for stable supersymmetric de Sitter space in higher-spin gravity?

sources.title: Quantum Gates to other Universes

evidence.text: Can two large holographic AdS4 universes be connected by a microscopic, local, quantized weak link, and what small graviton mass does that link generate?

sources.title: Comments on a state-operator correspondence for the torus

evidence.text: Can states of a three-dimensional CFT on a spatial two-torus admit a bijective state-operator correspondence based on compact Euclidean fillings? The central necessary test is whether such a filling can prepare the torus vacuum.

sources.title: Aspects of asymptotic safety for quantum gravity

evidence.text: Does removing regulator-induced curvature poles change interacting gravitational fixed points, their relevant directions, near-Gaussian higher-order scaling, or constant-curvature vacuum solutions?

sources.title: Entropy, Entanglement and Swampland Bounds in DS/dS

evidence.text: DS/dS proposes that gravity in a D-dimensional de Sitter bulk is described by two cutoff CFTs coupled to gravity on a d = D − 1 de Sitter slice.

sources.title: On the Limits of Effective Quantum Field Theory: Eternal Inflation, Landscapes, and Other Mythical Beasts

evidence.text: Can HST satisfy moving-observer overlap constraints and explicitly relate its AdS tensor networks to CFT and proper-time dynamics?

sources.title: Critical reflections on asymptotically safe gravity

evidence.text: What supports asymptotically safe gravity, which conceptual and technical obstacles remain, and how can fixed-point studies progress toward controlled calculations of observables?

sources.title: Constraining power of asymptotic safety for scalar fields

evidence.text: How sensitive are scalar-gravity fixed points and their relevant directions to regulator dependence and anomalous-dimension prescriptions? The appendix distinguishes scalar, metric-fluctuation, and background Newton-coupling anomalous dimensions.

sources.title: Kinematics of arbitrary spin matter fields in loop quantum gravity

evidence.text: How do the Gauss and spatial diffeomorphism constraints shape arbitrary-spin matter coupled to loop quantum gravity, and how far can this quantum kinematics be derived from classical higher-spin actions?

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Holography replaces selected strongly coupled field-theory questions with gravitational ones. Its classical use invokes large N, strong coupling and weak bulk curvature; these conditions delimit the calculational laboratory discussed in the window.

sources.title: Taming the landscape of effective theories

evidence.text: Can finiteness of quantum-gravity-compatible effective theories be implemented as a structural requirement that their parameter spaces, scalar field spaces, and coupling functions form tame, o-minimally definable geometry?

sources.title: Conformal field theories dual to quantum gravity with strongly coupled matter

evidence.text: Can holographic CFTs retain weak gravitational interactions while selected matter operators fail large-N factorization, thereby allowing matter interactions at the AdS scale rather than only Planck-suppressed interactions?

sources.title: Revisiting recent progress in the Karch–Randall braneworld

evidence.text: Can a diffeomorphism-invariant radiation region support an entanglement island in massless wedge gravity, can DGP terms change the answer, and what do holographic consistency and the precise intermediate description imply for brane couplings and causality?

sources.title: Constraining braneworlds with entanglement entropy

evidence.text: Can entropy positivity and causal wedge inclusion constrain brane-localized gravitational couplings, and thereby assess proposed islands and nontrivial Page curves in two-brane models containing massless gravity?

sources.title: End of the world brane meets $ T\overline{T} $

evidence.text: How can an EOW brane and a finite Dirichlet cutoff coexist in AdS gravity, and does partial reduction produce a gravitational system with a nonconformal T T̄ bath whose entropies and Page curves agree between island and holographic prescriptions?

sources.title: Robustness of the derivative expansion in asymptotic safety

evidence.text: Does the gravitational Reuter fixed point remain stable when a complete sixth-order derivative expansion is included in the minimal essential scheme, and how robust are its relevant directions and critical exponents under regulator changes?

sources.title: FeynGrav 3.0

evidence.text: How can recursive geometric expansions improve FeynGrav’s generation of perturbative gravitational Feynman rules, and how can its supported models be extended to Horndeski, scalar–Gauss–Bonnet, axion-like, massive-spin-2, and quadratic-gravity sectors?

sources.title: Consistent canonical quantization of gravity: Recovery of classical GR from BRST-invariant coherent states

evidence.text: Can BRST canonical quantization recover classical GR constraints and vanishing bulk Hamiltonian expectation while retaining nontrivial time evolution of metric expectation values?

sources.title: On the Positivity of de Sitter Group Averaging

evidence.text: On which domains is the de Sitter group-averaging inner product positive semidefinite, so that it can implement gravitational linearization-stability constraints? Does absolute convergence alone ensure positivity?

sources.title: Finiteness of quantum gravity coupled with matter in three space-time dimensions

evidence.text: Can three-dimensional quantum gravity coupled to interacting conformal matter be made finite by fixing irrelevant couplings, while retaining the Newton constant and matter marginal couplings as independent parameters?

sources.title: Investigating the Ultraviolet Properties of Gravity with a Wilsonian Renormalization Group Equation

evidence.text: For Δ=−∇²+E1+E2, cutoff types I, II and III use −∇², −∇²+E1 and full Δ respectively; E2 contains couplings. Type III is spectrally adjusted. Most explicit calculations use an optimized profile.

sources.title: Renormalizability of Massive Gravity in Three Dimensions

evidence.text: Counts derivatives and internal lines in 1PI diagrams, improves ghost counting using the asserted graviton transversality, and combines the divergence bound with a linearized Slavnov-Taylor renormalization equation to classify local counterterms.

sources.title: Emergent Spacetime and Holographic CFTs

evidence.text: Thermal tests use partition functions, KMS periodicity, spatial clustering, and temperature response expressed through integrated connected stress-tensor insertions. The latter requires regularization and removal of temperature-independent divergences; independence of the proposed thermal constraints is not established.

sources.title: Renormalization of Higher Derivative Quantum Gravity Coupled to a Scalar with Shift Symmetry

evidence.text: Spin-projector decomposition and inversion of the gauge-fixed quadratic action produce graviton and scalar propagators. In Landau gauge these are stated to fall as k⁻⁴, while the Faddeev-Popov ghost propagator falls as k⁻².

sources.title: Further evidence for asymptotic safety of quantum gravity

evidence.text: Expand the fixed-point equation about R=0. Algebraic recursion expresses every λ_n for n≥2 as a rational function of λ_0 and λ_1. Numerically select real roots consistent across orders, reject coincident denominator zeros, and compare both coordinates and eigenvalues.

sources.title: The unitary conformal field theory behind 2D Asymptotic Safety

evidence.text: Expands the Einstein–Hilbert functional under Weyl rescalings after subtracting its Euler-characteristic pole. The finite Weyl variation is related to a Liouville/Wess–Zumino functional; Diff×Weyl invariance restricts the remaining ambiguity to moduli dependence.
